params.title: Time estimates
params.description: How many hours an object in another app is expected to take, and whether that number is a ceiling.
params.note: estimate-spent-and-remaining-on-an-hours-leaf (2026-09-18): REQ-HL-EST-001. There is NO remaining column, and that is the point: remaining is estimated minus booked, derived on read by TimeEstimateService, so deleting an entry moves it at once and no stored figure can go stale. `enforced` is a column because it changes what happens on a write: false refuses nothing, true refuses a new entry past the ceiling naming the hours left, and a stopped timer lands either way. The expected number itself belongs to the consuming app, which writes it from its own policy (REQ-HL-EST-005); this page is where an administrator reads and corrects one.

params.note: estimate-spent-and-remaining-on-an-hours-leaf (2026-09-18): a plain dated fact with no lifecycle, so no lifecycleActions widget. domainObjectType and domainObjectRef stay ON the data widget rather than being excluded: they are what this estimate is ABOUT, and the object lives in another app, so Related cannot resolve it into a name.
